content: Jesus Pilate Mai Ah
Zingsang hong thet ciang in thiampi lian te le upa te theampo in Jesus that tu in kikum khawm uh hi:
Amate in a lehhen zawk uh ciang, ngam uk Pontius Pilate kungah paipui in ap uh hi.
Judas Iscariot Thina Thu
Tuazawkciang in Jesus a leheak pa Judas in, Topa sia thalup tu in maw ki suan hi, ci a mu ciang in, ki sikkik a, dangka sawmthum sia thiampi lian te le upa te kungah puak kik in,
Mawna nei ngawl pa thisan ka ap thak man in khial khi hi, ci hi. Amate in, ko taw bang kisai ziam? nangma taw kisai bek hi, ci uh hi.
Ama in tua dangka sia biakinn sungah lawn a, mundang ah pai in ama le ama ngui awk hi.
Thiampi lian te in, tua dangka te la a, hi sum sia thisan man a hikom in, biakinn neisa te sungah koi tu kilawm ngawl hi, ci uh hi.
Amate kikum khawm uh a, ngamdang mite ki phum natu in bealvawtpa lo lei uh hi.
Tua ahikom tua lo sia, tu ni dong in thisan lo, kici hi.
Kamsang Jeremiah in a sonkholna ah, Israel mite in a kitat na uh man dangka sawmthum sia amate in la a;
Topa thupiak na bang in bealvawtpa lo lei hi, a ci thu tangtung hi.
Pilate in Jesus Thu Dong
Jesus sia ngam uk pa mai ah ding a, tua ngam uk pa in, nangma sia Judah Kumpipa ni ziam? ci in dong hi; taciang Jesus in,

Thiampi lian te le upa te in ama a mawsiat ciang in kamkhat zong zo kik ngawl hi.
Tuazawkciang in Pilate in, nangma hong ki mawsiat na tetti theampo za ngawl ni ziam? ci hi.
Jesus in kamkhat zong a zo kik ngawl ciang in: ngam uk pa in lamdangsa mama hi.
Jesus le Barabbas
Tua poai sungah ngam uk pa in thongtak te sung pan, mipi te dei khat suatak thei hi.
Tua ahikom thongtak te sungah Barabbas a kici a minthang mama khat om hi.
Tua ahikom mipite hong ki kaikhop ciang, Pilate in amate tung ah, kua na suaktasak nuam uh ziam? Barabbas maw, Christ a kici Jesus? ci hi.
Banghangziam cile Pilate in amate in Jesus sia el ahikom hong ap hi, ci he hi.
Pilate sia thukhenna tokhum tung a to ciang in, a zi in mikhat sawl a, hi thutangpa tungah bangma vawt heak in, banghangziam cile tuni ka mang sungah ama hang in tampitak thuak khi hi, ci hi.
Ahihang thiampi lian te le upa te in mihonpi te sia Barabbas ngen tu le Jesus that tu in hol uh hi.
Pilate in hi ni te sung pan a kua suatak tu dei nu ziam? ci in a dok ciang, amate in Barabbas suatak tu dei khu hi, ci uh hi.
Tua a hile Christ a kici Jesus sia banglaw tu khi ziam? ci in Pilate in a dok ciang in, amate theampo in, thinglamte tungah khaina thuak tahen, ci uh hi.
Taciang ngam uk pa in, banghangziam, bang khialna vawt ziam? a ci ciang in, amate in thinglamte tungah ki khai tahen, ci in au seseam uh hi.
Pilate in zo nawn ngawl khi hi, mipi te ngamlum siat hi, ci a mu ciang, tui la in, a khut sil a, hi a thutang pa thisan pan ka thiang hi: no ma khensat tavun, ci hi.
Tasiaciang in mi theampo in, hi sia pa i thisan koma le ka tate tungah om tahen, ci tek uh hi.
Taciang Pilate in Barabbas suatak a: Jesus sia a sat zawkciang thinglamte tungah khai tu in ap hi.
Ngalkap te in Jesus Selno
Tuazawkciang Pilate ngalkap te in Jesus sia ngam uk pa inn ah paipui uh a, ngalkap hon bup ama kim ah kikhawm hi.
Amate in a puan te sutkeak in, puan sannum silsak uh hi.
Amate in lingtaw a ki pheak ling lukhu a lu tungah khusak uh a, a ziatsang khut ah phai kung khat toaisak uh hi: taciang a mai ah khupdin in, Judah te kumpipa! na khansau tahen, ci in selno uh hi.
Amate in ama tungah cilphi uh a, a phaikung la in a lu pan vel uh hi.
Tabang in a selno uh zawkciang a puan tual hawksak kik in, ama puan sil sakkik uh hi, tua zawkciang thinglamte tungah khen tu in paipui uh hi.
Jesus Thinglamte Tung ah
Tabang in a paipui uh laitak, Simon a kici, Cyrene khuami khat mu uh a: thinglamte zawthawk thu taw puasak uh hi.
Amate in Golgotha a kici lu ngu mual a thet uh ciang in,
Jesus sia sapittui le a kha a kihel pia uh hi: ama in tep bek a, dawn nuam ngawl hi.
Jesus sia thinglamte tungah khai uh a, a puan te a khen zawk uh ciang in, aisan nataw hawm uh hi: tua thu sia kamsangpa sonkholna, amate in ka puan te aisan in hawm uh hi, ci thu a tangtunna a hihi.
Tuazawkciang tua mun ah to in ama encik uh hi.
A lu tung san ah mawsiatna lai, HI SIA JUDAH TE KUMPIPA JESUS HI ci in at uh hi.
Ama taw nguta ni te zong a ziatsang ah khat, a veisang zong ah a dang khat, thinglamte tungah khai uh hi.
Lampi ah a vak te in zong nu nau in, a lu thin uh a;
Biakinn pheltham in nithum sung a sakik tu pa, nangma le nangma ki hun in. Pathian Tapa na hile, thinglamte tung pan tuaksuk in, ci uh hi.
Tasia bangma in thiampi lian te, thukhamhil te le, upa te zong in nu nau in,
Ama in ngualdang ngum thei a, ama le ama ki ngum thei ngawl hi. Ama sia Israel te kumpipa a hile thinglamte tung pan tu mama in tuak hen a, tasiaciang in ka um tu uh hi, ci uh hi.
Ama in Pathian muang a; keima sia Pathian Tapa khi hi, ci a hi ciang, tu mama in Pathian in suaktasak hen: ci in nu nau tek uh hi.
Ama taw thinglamte tungah a ki khai nguta te zong in, tabangma in nu nau uh hi.
Jesus Thina
Sun nai sawmleni pan nitak sang nai thum dong leitung theampo khuazing hi.
Nai thum kim ciang in, Jesus a nging tatak in,
ci in au hi, a khiakna sia, Ka Pathian, Ka Pathian, banghang in hong taisan ni ziam? a cinopna hi.
Tua mun ah a ding te pawlkhat in a zak uh ciang in, Elijah sam hi, ci uh hi.
Tasia pociang amate sung pan khat tai a, tuihup puan la in, sapittui hau sungah a papsuk zawkciang, phaikung dawn ah hen in, Jesus dawn tu in pia hi.
A dang te in, ngak hi vun, Elijah ama hun tu in hongpai tha tu hi, ci en tawng, ci uh hi.
Jesus ngingtak in au kik in thi hi.
Taciang in, en vun, biakinn sung sang kidalna puan sia a lu pan a taw dong khen ni in ki khen suk hi; zin zong ling in, suangtum te zong kektham a,
Thankul te ki hong in; a thisa mithiangtho tampi te thokik hi,
Amate than sung pan pusuak uh a, Jesus thawkik zawkciang in, khuapi thiangtho sungah pai uh a, mi tampi te kungah kilang uh hi.
Ngalkap zakhat uk pa le a kungah omte in Jesus en in, zinling le thupiang dang te a mu uh ciang in, lau mama uh a, hisia pa Pathian Tapa tatak hi, ci uh hi.
Galilee pan Jesus a zui te le a khoi numei tampi te in, a khuala na pan en tek uh hi:
Tua numei te sungah Mary Magdalene, James le Joses te nu Mary le Zebedee zi zong ki hel hi.
Jesus Than ah Ki Vui
Nitak sang ciang in, Arimathea khua pan mihau pa khat hongpai hi, a min sia Joseph kici a, Jesus nungzui khat a hihi:
Ama Pilate kungah pai a, Jesus luanghawm ngen hi. Tasiaciang Pilate in Jesus luanghawm piak tu in thupia hi.
Taciang Joseph in Jesus luanghawm a lak zawkciang, puanneam thiang taw tun in,
Ama atu in a taw suang hawng thankul sungah vui hi: than kongkha ah suangtum lian mama khat lik in a kha zawkciang pai hi.
Mary Magdalene le a dang Mary te sia tua mun ah thankul sang nga in to uh hi.
Than Cing Te
Ki ngin ni a zingciang in, thiampi lian te le Pharisee te Pilate kungah hongpai uh a,
Topa awng, tua leilot thu son pa in a nuntak lai in, nithum zawkciang thokik tu khi hi, a ci sia phawkkik khu hi, ci uh hi.

A nungzui te zan ciang hongpai in a luanghawm ngu a, thina pan thokik zo hi: ci in midang te tungah son a hile, a nungsang thu sia a masa sang in poimaw zaw tu hi, tua ahiciang a than sia nithum dong cing tu in thupia in, ci uh hi.
Pilate in amate tung ah, a cing tu nei nu hi: pai tavun a, na hitheitawp in vawt vun, ci hi.
Tua ahikom amate zong than ah pai in, thankul kha na suangpheak tungah ceptena khen in, a cing te koi uh hi.
